_about: UI Story Ad #10 v2 'Gold Ledger' (afterpranav, Top-100 rank 10), 8 Oct 2026, matched frame by frame to his real-estate ad. Opens on a WHITE page: the spoken line types on at the top in small dark sans, over a map in a soft green glow with a red pin, and round portrait avatars with blue star badges pop in around it. Then a warm, saturated talking head: a small white italic sans lead line, with ONE big heavy italic CAPS keyword in a gold gradient under it at chest height. White UI pops over the footage: a rounded white map card with yellow pins, and a checklist of white pills with green slanted tabs and white glyphs, one per spoken item, which blurs out. A quick white wash between ideas. A white photo page: a grey tilted frame with a dark label pill, over a blue disc that pulses on each swap. The ref file is a silent portfolio export, so the sound is chosen for the genre, not matched.

director.style: UI Story Ad #10 'Gold Ledger': a premium talking-head ad told with white UI. Warm and confident.
director.open: headpage at 0 for 3-5 s: the first spoken line types on top; src = a map (or object) of what the line is about, pin true; avatars (3-6 round portraits) pop on the words about people.
director.captions: captions.keys: ONE key word per phrase (the payoff noun or adjective): gold italic caps under a small italic lead line.
director.ui: uicard (white map/screen card, pins) on a place or a scope ('around the world'); pills when the speaker lists 3-4 things (one pill per item, at its word; glyphs: check doc report chart people globe image book archive museum home shield heart clock star bolt mask tree); photostack page (2-3 photos with short labels) near the end; whiteflash on a change of idea or speaker.
director.sound: alif-match-a bed at -20 dB; pop per pill and avatar; pop-whoosh on cards; whoosh on the white wash.
